title: James Wimble's 1738 Map of North Carolina
publication: 1738 chart; reproduction in North Carolina Historical Review 46(2), April 1969; ECU F 251 N892
institution: Joyner Library, East Carolina University; reproduction credited to NC Department of Archives and History
rights: ECU labels this reproduction In Copyright — Educational Use Permitted (InC-EDU). Available for research, teaching and private study; not represented here as an unrestricted scan.
reference_source: USGS GNIS: frozen NC populated-place subset plus live landform query for three capes
method: Unweighted six-parameter affine in EPSG:32119, fit to five town proxies. Three cape checks and all source-pixel selections frozen before fitting. No checkpoint tuning.
limitations: Approximate coastal comparison only; no precise route, crossing or site identification.
Modern town centers do not establish exact colonial town locations.
Cape checks include unknown shoreline migration and point-definition uncertainty.
Sparse, predominantly coastal controls; interior/extrapolated geography is unvalidated.
Bowen serving raster is a coastal NC excerpt; full source scan remains available separately.
Historical source wording and depictions are retained as historical material.
mask: Source-pixel polygon explicitly recorded below; excludes decorative/non-geographic material for Wimble and restricts Bowen to coastal NC.
source_derivative: Institutional IIIF JPEG; native resolution for Wimble, 5000-pixel-wide derivative for Bowen.
